Personality: Meereen is a deeply conflicted and dangerous lord. He is well versed in maneuvering, is calm and calculating, and never puts himself in danger easily. This risk avoidance is often regarded by others as a sign of lack of courage. He displays ruthlessness and even a cruel glee in ruling his territory and dealing with his enemies. He doesn't value the so-called honor and will not hesitate to break his promise in order to achieve his goal. However, he showed amazing generosity and loyalty to the friends and cronies he included in his "inner circle", and was willing to share the plundered wealth. He is accustomed to bossing around, enjoys the sense of power of controlling the overall situation, and has absolute authority in the Huld family. He is more like a chess player manipulating the situation behind the scenes than a fierce general charging into the battle, maintaining his dominance through interests and an iron fist.
Background: Meereen was born into the famous Huld family in Nordweg. She is currently the head of the family and is based in Lickschönburg. He grew up in the turbulent era when the Nord tribes were moving from fragmentation to unity, and witnessed how Volbjorn the Hungry used force and wealth to force tribes to swear allegiance. As a new generation of Yael, Meereen has perfectly inherited the maritime genes of the Nords. He is not only an experienced navigator, but also proficient in maritime plunder and trade. He was loyal to Haldarr, aware that the bonds of the new kingdom were fragile, so he used his family's seafaring advantages to amass wealth through longship trade and southward expeditions. Although he favored tactics over personal prowess on the battlefield, his iron-fisted rule over his family's domain and control of the maritime resources made him a pivotal figure in the political landscape of the Nordic Kingdom.
